subject: Re: Discovery - Bancorp LLM Assistant (post-call recap & eval plan)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@bancorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery - Bancorp LLM Assistant (post-call recap & eval plan)

Thanks for the time today, Jordan - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off a targeted eval on Redwood.

Call notes (short):
- Goal: pilot a customer-facing LLM assistant to surface account balances, transaction summaries, and product recommendations while meeting Bancorp security/compliance requirements.
- Success metrics: <10% critical errors on information retrieval workflows; 90th percentile latency <600ms for common prompts; human-rated quality >=4/5 on sample prompt set.
- Data constraints: PII must never be used for model training; logs required for 90 days.

Initial model recommendations (tradeoffs):
- rw-13b-q4 (recommended starting point) - good balance of cost/latency, strong on short-form slot-filling and retrieval-augmented generation.
- rw-70b-q8 (quality-focused) - higher quality on nuanced instructions, recommended for final user-facing rollout or high-value flows.
- fallback path: rw-7b-instruct (fast, low-cost) for lower-risk flows.

Evaluation plan (high level):
1) We run a customer-specific eval on Redwood using your sample dataset and prompt set. Expected artifacts: per-prompt scoring (automated metrics + human labels), model-level comparisons, and a recommendation matrix (cost vs quality).
2) Setup: you provide a CSV or JSONL with columns: input, expected_output, intent, sensitivity (low/medium/high), and an optional case_id. We attached a sample CSV (sample_dataset_bancorp.csv) and a prompt set (bancorp_prompt_set_v1.jsonl).
3) Scoring criteria: automated checks (exact match/token overlap, BLEU/ROUGE where applicable), semantic similarity (embedding-based), and a small human evaluation rubric (1-5) for factuality and appropriateness.

Next steps (action items):
- Jordan: share the cleaned dataset or a secure Drive link to the sample (if any PII, share via SFTP or your KMS-backed storage).
- Jordan: confirm which flows to prioritize (balances, transactions, product recs).
- Marissa/Neha: create an eval job on Redwood, upload dataset, run rw-13b-q4 and rw-70b-q8 for comparison, and share the results within 3 business days after dataset receipt.
- Vivek: provide technical checklist for onboarding (IAM roles, network egress, eval config).

Attachments: bancorp_prompt_set_v1.jsonl (sample prompts), sample_dataset_bancorp.csv (sample rows).

Thanks - I'll follow up with a kickoff calendar invite once we have the dataset link.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from our side: 
- We can share a sanitized CSV today for the balances and transaction summarization flows. The product recommendations dataset will take a bit longer.
- Security: we need to confirm that the eval runs do not use our data for model training and that logs follow our retention window. Can you point me to the docs or config where those controls are enforced?
- Cost/SLA: what are the expected unit costs for rw-13b-q4 vs rw-70b-q8 for evaluation runs? Also want to confirm throughput if we run a 5k prompt job.

If you can send a short tech checklist and estimated cost numbers, we'll prioritize sending the sanitized CSV today. I’ll loop in procurement once we have a rough spend estimate.

Regards,
Jordan Ellis
Head of Data Products, Bancorp
jordan.ellis@bancorp.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@bancorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery - Bancorp LLM Assistant (post-call recap & eval plan)

Great - thanks Jordan. Quick answers and next steps from the sales/ops side: 
- Training/data usage: Redwood has a per-customer policy to opt-out of using customer eval data for model training. For Private/Dedicated customers we can provide additional guarantees. We will include the project-level "no-train" flag for your eval job. David (cc) can confirm audit logs.
- Cost: rough order of magnitude (for eval runs): rw-13b-q4 ~ $0.002 per prompt; rw-70b-q8 ~ $0.012 per prompt (these are evaluation estimate rates - actual pricing will be in the contract). A 5k prompt job is therefore ~ $10 (13b) to $60 (70b) in raw compute; network/storage and human labeling add on.
- Throughput: With a default dedicated job we can sustain ~80-120 qps on rw-13b-q4; rw-70b-q8 depends on instance class (we'll recommend a c5/high-single-tenant config for stable throughput).

Attached is a short onboarding doc (MVP_eval_instructions.pdf) that shows the dataset format and the UI flow - I’ve highlighted the fields we need. For the pilot, simplest dataset formats we accept: CSV (utf-8) or JSONL (one object per line) with these keys: input, expected_output, case_id, sensitivity. Example rows are in sample_dataset_bancorp.csv.

Can you confirm the sanitized CSV link (or a SFTP token) and which 1-2 flows you want prioritized? Once we have the file we’ll spin up the eval and share a results dashboard with per-prompt metrics + a short writeup.

Next internal step: Marissa will create the HubSpot milestone and I'll prep an internal eval run template. I'll also coordinate with David for the formal audit log sample.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Director, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@bancorp.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery - Bancorp LLM Assistant (post-call recap & eval plan)

Hi Jordan - quick tech checklist and steps to get your eval running on Redwood: 

1) Account & access
- We will provision a sandbox project in your org. Send the Drive/SFTP link or upload to the secure bucket we'll create. For sensitive data please use your KMS-backed storage; we support S3-compatible signed URLs and SFTP.
- IAM: create a service account (name: bancorp-eval-sa) with read-only access to the dataset bucket and API keys scoped to eval.create and eval.read. We will provide a one-time onboarding key for the console.

2) Dataset format (accepted):
- CSV (utf-8) - header row required. Columns we use: case_id, input, expected_output, intent, sensitivity.
- JSONL - one object per line with the same keys.
- Max recommended size for quick turn-around: 5k rows. For larger jobs we recommend batching the run into 5k chunks.

3) Eval config sample (console / API):
- model_variants: ["rw-13b-q4", "rw-70b-q8"]
- scorer: ["automated_similarity", "exact_match", "human_review"]
- metrics: ["exact_match_pct", "avg_embedding_similarity", "human_quality_score"]
- retention_policy: "90_days" (can be set per-customer)

4) Human labeling:
- If you want human judgments, upload a small subset (~500 examples) to the labeling queue. We provide a simple rubric (1-5) for factuality/appropriateness and will return per-example labels in the results JSON.

5) Running the job (API snippet):
- POST /v1/evals with body {"project":"bancorp-eval","input_uri":"s3://bancorp-eval/sample_dataset_bancorp.csv","config":{...}}
- We'll run the job on the requested model_variants and post results to the dashboard link (shared after job creation).

6) Security & logs:
- We'll set the project-level flag no_train=true for this eval. Audit logs include request/response hashes, timestamp, and execution node id; David can share a sanitized sample.

7) Recommended hardware for 5k run (timing estimates):
- rw-13b-q4: single 80-120 qps m5d-like instance - expect full run in ~1-2 minutes plus postprocessing.
- rw-70b-q8: requires a larger GPU-backed instance - expect completion in ~4-8 minutes for a 5k batch depending on sequence lengths.

I'll stand up the sandbox as soon as you provide the dataset link. If you want, we can also schedule a 30-min kickoff with our platform engineer to walk through the dataset upload and the eval UI.

Links:
- Eval benchmark (placeholder): https://redwood.inference/benchmarks/bancorp-eval-2026
- Shared drive w/ sample: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2BancorpEvalShare

If there are any security-specific questions, loop in David (copied) and he'll provide the audit evidence and SOC/SLA language.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
